certificate.proof: The nonzero determinant modulo a prime implies a nonzero integer determinant. The Gram matrix is positive definite. Its eigenvalues are at most the infinity norm, so its least eigenvalue is at least that bound to power -(dimension-1).
certificate.weighted_consequence: For binary weights, the projected central-bulk pair on degree 3 equals lambda times this link pair, up to orientation signs.

topology_certificate.rank_proof: Rational ranks are at least ranks modulo the prime. Each rank is at most either adjacent chain dimension minus the adjacent rank. The recorded lower and upper bounds agree.
topology_certificate.survivor_proof: The boundary rank over Q is certified exactly. Appending the three cycle columns increases rank by three modulo the prime, hence also over Q.
topology_certificate.register_intersection: Exactly the span of ket00-ket10-ket11: that cycle has an explicit rational filling and three complementary register cycles survive independently.
topology_certificate.positive_weight_extension: Invertible diagonal weight gauge preserves homology; weight-one register coordinates preserve the exact register boundary intersection for every lambda>0.

zero_weight_certificate.register_basis_gram: 16 I_4; divide each cycle by 4 for an isometry
zero_weight_certificate.positive_gap_proof: For an integral PSD Gram matrix of rank r and norm at most B, its nonzero eigenvalue product is a positive integer, so the least positive eigenvalue is at least B^(-(r-1)).
zero_weight_certificate.weighted_gap_proof: For each boundary, partial_w=W_rows^(-1) partial_1 W_columns. The left scaling has minimum singular value at least one; a degree-k column weight is at least lambda^(k+1). Nonzero singular values therefore decrease by at most that factor. At target degree 3 this gives a whole positive Laplacian lower bound c lambda^10.
zero_weight_certificate.not_certified: Leading eigenvalue coefficient, optimal valuation, and guarded-palette closure are not implied by this certificate.
